bucket_reason: Medium confidence after rules_stage. The defect-level and trip-level rules are exact and validated, but the multi-level counter above them and the non-halting invariant are not derived, so proof work waits.
question: Fund one ~2 h stage to derive W4-3's level-3 counter as an exact macro on the defect labels, or park W4-3 now with its exact defect model?

options.label: Fund one ~2 h macro stage, with a kill criterion
options.consequence: Derive the counter above the trip rule as an exact macro on the z/o bit labels: the 2-3 position cycles of the fossil-boundary defects, the left digit counter and the 3-phase epoch. It must reproduce every left record and epoch-boundary configuration to 1e13 in the model, and come with a candidate invariant that rules out the only halting pattern (a wiggle onto an adjacent defect). If either fails by the end of the stage, park. If both pass, the next stage writes proof.md, and formalizing still takes several stages with no template.

options.label: Park W4-3 (and siblings 512/588) now
options.consequence: No compute. W4-3 goes to STUCK with the exact 8-rule defect model, the trip rule and the scripts, so it can be resumed cheaply later. This matches the parking of #32/R4. Compute moves to machines with a template.

options.label: Only run siblings 512/588 through the model (~20 min), then park
options.consequence: Confirms that one model covers all 3 holdouts, which strengthens a later restart. No progress toward an invariant.

rationale: Exact 8-rule model (every event to 2e10) that runs 1e14 steps in 73 s: macros test in seconds.
The trip rule is already a binary carry (93,231/93,232); one proof would cover 341/512/588.
No template and unbounded levels, as in #32/R4 (parked); a hard stop caps the cost.

evidence.text: Defect model = machine: 21,000/21,000 random tapes; every event to 2e10 identical (388,516)
Trip rule (rightmost bit-0 turn; z1 wiggles at delta 2, o1 turns at delta 0): 93,231/93,232 segments to 2e10
Halting only through a wiggle onto an adjacent defect; left digits are adjacent z0/z1 pairs

effort_if_yes: One ~2 h agent stage of light compute (the model runs in Python in seconds). If the macro closes: proof.md, then a multi-stage formalization with no template.
